title: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention Protocol (v2)
changelog: v2: Added proactive alerting, idle detection integration, automatic escalation timers, and evidence-based polling intervals from T24-T27 data
improvements_over_v1: Added proactive alerting thresholds (v1 was reactive-only)
Integrated with HelpProtocol idle detection for automatic work reassignment
Added progress velocity tracking (not just point-in-time snapshot)
Added automatic escalation timers that fire without coordinator polling
Tightened CP-1 to 15-30s based on T27 data (90s full audit proves fast starts)
Added CP-1.5 at 2 minutes for early blocker detection
Added team-size-aware monitoring (different intervals for 3-agent vs 15-agent teams)

section_1_proactive_alerting.title: Proactive Alert System
section_1_proactive_alerting.description: Instead of relying solely on coordinator polling, agents self-report anomalies. Reduces coordinator monitoring overhead by 40-60%.

agent_self_alerts.description: Agents append alert entries to the bus when they detect issues with their own progress.

alert_types.trigger: Agent has not made measurable progress in 3+ minutes
alert_types.auto_action: Agent writes alert to bus; coordinator receives on next poll

alert_types.trigger: Agent realizes it's working outside its assigned scope
Agent has waited 5+ minutes for another agent's output
alert_types.auto_action: Agent falls back to independent work or requests reassignment

velocity_tracking.description: Track progress rate, not just progress level. A team at 30% after 5 minutes is fine; at 30% after 25 minutes is concerning.

section_2_team_size_aware_monitoring.title: Team-Size-Aware Polling Schedule
section_2_team_size_aware_monitoring.description: Based on analysis of T05 (1 agent), T06 (3 agents), T24 (8 agents), T25 (15 agents), T27 (5 agents).

small_team_1_to_3.rationale: Small teams finish fast. T27 did full audit in 90s. Check early, intervene fast.

medium_team_4_to_9.cp1_5_early_blocker: 2 minutes (new: catch import errors, missing files)
medium_team_4_to_9.rationale: Optimal team size per analysis. Standard monitoring works well.

large_team_10_plus.cp2_5_coordination_check: 8 minutes (new: check for duplicate work, resource conflicts)
large_team_10_plus.cp3_mid_session: When 30% elapsed (earlier due to higher coordination overhead)
large_team_10_plus.cp4_5_redistribution: When 50% of agents complete (new: actively redistribute remaining work)
large_team_10_plus.rationale: Large teams have 25-30% coordination overhead. Earlier/more frequent checks catch issues before they compound.

section_3_automatic_escalation_timers.title: Automatic Escalation Timers
section_3_automatic_escalation_timers.description: Set timers at launch that fire automatically, reducing coordinator cognitive load.

timers.delay: 3 minutes after any agent reports blocked
timers.rationale: T25 data: blocked agents that waited >3 min for coordinator intervention wasted 100% of remaining time

timers.delay: 1 minute after any agent reports complete
timers.action: Check for incomplete agents; if any, auto-reassign idle agent via WorkStealing queue
timers.rationale: T27 achieved zero idle time by immediately reassigning completers

timers.action: Mandatory progress review regardless of other checkpoints
timers.rationale: Catches slow-burning issues that individual checkpoints miss

section_4_idle_detection_integration.title: Integration with HelpProtocol Idle Detection
section_4_idle_detection_integration.description: Uses existing HelpProtocol.get_idle_teams() and auto_assign_idle_teams() for automatic work redistribution.
workflow: 2. For each idle team, check WorkStealing queue for available work
3. If work available: auto-assign via WorkStealing.steal_work()
4. If no queued work but other teams struggling: create ad-hoc help request
5. If no work at all: assign knowledge documentation tasks (write KB entries, update indexes)
section_4_idle_detection_integration.never_leave_agents_idle: T27 proved that zero idle time is achievable with 5 agents. The key is pre-loading the work queue with fallback tasks so every completer has something to pick up immediately.

note: The full v1 content (status file design, intervention actions, completion handling) remains valid and is inherited. This v2 adds the proactive layer on top.
